sloka: एवमुक्ता तु वेदेही प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् ।अस्नाता द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं राक्षसाधिप ।। ६.११७.१० ।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vedehī pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam ।asnātā draṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṁ rākṣasādhipa ।। 6.117.10 ।।

translations.english: "Vaidehi! Anointed with a wonderful fragrance, decked with beautiful ornaments, auspicious and ascending the palanquin, your husband desires to see you."
